body:
Dedup keywords: `object-validation-engine.test` · `dialect cel ast missing source` · `ValidationRule source required` · `spec main shape gate TS2322 dialect` · `core validation engine fixture`

Reported by the **Spec Main Shape Gate** on PR objectui#9877, check run `105804001660`, on head `2b3836f07` at `2026-09-19T00:19:51Z`. Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat. ⛔ Ungraded and ⛔ unrouted.

## The diagnostic, quoted from the gate's own table

| objectui file | line | code |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/object-validation-engine.test.ts` | 162 | TS2322 |

> Type `{ dialect: "cel"; ast: { op: string; args: never[]; }; }` is not assignable to type `string \| { dialect: "cel" \| "cron" \| "template"; source: string; ast?: unknown; meta?: { rationale?: string \| undefined; generatedBy?: string \| undefined; } \| undefined; }`.

Compiled against `objectstack-ai/objectstack@87f776bd7210`.

## What it says

The expression object the fixture authors carries `dialect` and `ast` but **no `source`**, and on today's objectstack `main` the declared shape makes `source: string` **required** — `ast` is the optional one. ⇒ an authored expression that names its dialect and hands over a parsed AST, without the text it was parsed from, is no longer a thing the contract accepts.

⭐ This is a **different break from the `page` retirement** that the rest of this family is about: different member, different union, no relation to `ViewType`. It happens to surface in the same gate run.

⚠️ ⛔ Not measured by this seat: whether any **non-test** objectui code authors the same `{ dialect, ast }`-without-`source` shape. If it does, the fixture is the smaller half of the problem and the card's scope is wrong — that census is the first thing whoever takes this card should run, with its control lit.

## Why it matters now

It is one of only **2** diagnostics the gate currently reports (down from 20), and it blocks objectui#9860 (`priority:p1`), the card holding PR objectui#9877. ⚠️ That 2 is a **lower bound**: `Tasks: 18 successful, 24 total`, failing at `@object-ui/core#type-check`, so 6 tasks never ran — objectui#9944's property.
